versions.changelog:
- Simplified and reorganized documentation for easier onboarding and usage.
- Added a new "What you can say" section with common intents and example commands.
- Updated safety guidance: all actions from briefings now require explicit user approval before taking effect.
- Clarified and streamlined key workflows: listing topics, subscribing, forking, creating topics, and generating briefings.
- Improved instructions for topic and source group management.
- Minor updates to argument hints for more intuitive invocation.

Header skill initial release — enables continuous, actionable intelligence for agents.

- Subscribe to curated or custom topics and receive synthesized briefings from RSS, YouTube, Reddit, and newsletters.
- Structured briefings include "What to do", insights, patterns, and a reading list, with action items surfaced first.
- Supports both supervised (user approval) and autonomous (self-improving) modes with clear safety guidance.
- Offers complete Bash command examples for subscribing, topic/goal management, fetching briefings, and setting up new topics.
- Requires a HEADER_API_KEY for authenticated use.
